name: Rapid multi-exercise gym montage
description: Eleven independently recorded half-second exercise setups assembled with exact hard cuts, one identity anchor and a persistent commitment caption.
lockedGrammar: One identity lineage across every setup
Different exercise, angle and outfit per take

variables.description: One fictional or authorized exerciser reused across all shots.
variables.defaultValue: a clearly new fictional athletic adult with a consistent face, hair and body
examples: a blonde woman with a bob
a Black man with short curls

variables.description: Varied but coherent workout palette across shots.
variables.defaultValue: black, navy, lime, white, mauve, blue, magenta and purple gymwear
Locking in for the next 4 months.
examples: Training with GymLevels for the next 4 months.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation in {{wardrobe_palette}}, bent over beside a grey gym wall for a single-arm kettlebell row.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Immediately perform one strong single-arm kettlebell pull with causal shoulder, elbow and weight motion; locked phone camera.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{wardrobe_palette}} on an open weights floor, set for a lateral medicine-ball drive.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Drive laterally with the medicine ball immediately at real-time speed; keep identity and camera stable.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{wardrobe_palette}} on green turf, in a weighted push-up position between plates.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Perform the visible weighted push-up phase with causal torso and arm motion from frame zero.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{wardrobe_palette}} behind a gym sled on green turf near an EXIT pillar.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Drive the sled forward immediately with forceful alternating steps and stable equipment geometry.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{wardrobe_palette}} beside a concrete pillar, set for a resisted high-knee on a round plate.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Perform the resisted high-knee phase immediately with causal leg and band motion.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{wardrobe_palette}} at a chest-supported row station in the dumbbell area, rear view.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Perform one clear chest-supported single-arm row phase with the dumbbell path visible.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{wardrobe_palette}} in a dynamic plank on green turf against a grey wall.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Perform the source-style plank shoulder-tap action, keeping hips controlled; do not substitute mountain climbers.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{wardrobe_palette}} hinged over a barbell plate on green turf.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Begin a controlled hinged plate-lift phase immediately with stable hands, spine and plate geometry.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{wardrobe_palette}} supported on a bench by a blue wall for a dumbbell row.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Perform one supported dumbbell-row phase immediately with causal elbow and weight motion.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{wardrobe_palette}} by a gym window wall holding a jump rope.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Jump rope continuously with a clean stable rope arc and natural landing rhythm.

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: The same {{subject_identity}} in {{wardrobe_palette}} on green turf by a cable station, set for an elevated dumbbell split squat.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: Perform the split-squat phase with a controlled vertical path and stable rear-foot support.
Hold full black through the final 52 milliseconds.

deterministicLayers.template: Render exact centered text ‘{{caption_text}}’ persistently across all eleven exercise shots.

promptExamples: Use the rapid gym montage format with a blonde woman, black-and-green outfits, and caption it ‘Training with GymLevels’.

notes: Exact eleven-shot order and ten hard-cut boundaries passed deterministic verification.
Remaining weaknesses were isolated to motion accuracy in row/plank units and one authorized-source fallback.
